headline: PM unveils three-volume book on Ziaur Rahman
summary: The publication, titled 'Bir Rashtranayak Ziaur Rahman', explores the former president's leadership, development philosophy, and contributions to national life.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman unveiled the cover of a three-volume book titled 'Bir Rashtranayak Ziaur Rahman' today at the Prime Minister's office in the Secretariat.
The book was written by researcher and writer Kalam Foyezy, focusing on the life and legacy of the former president.
According to a press release from the PMO, the publication discusses Ziaur Rahman's role in state affairs and his leadership style.
It further delves into his development philosophy and the significant contributions he made to national life.
The three-volume set specifically focuses on different phases of Ziaur Rahman's political and administrative roles.
caption:
A new three-volume exploration of Ziaur Rahman's legacy has been unveiled by the Prime Minister.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman unveiled the cover of a three-volume book titled 'Bir Rashtranayak Ziaur Rahman' today at the Prime Minister's office in the Secretariat.

The book was written by researcher and writer Kalam Foyezy, focusing on the life and legacy of the former president.

According to a press release from the PMO, the publication discusses Ziaur Rahman's role in state affairs and his leadership style.

It further delves into his development philosophy and the significant contributions he made to national life.

The three-volume set specifically focuses on different phases of Ziaur Rahman's political and administrative roles.

headline: 34-match unbeaten run: Spain face Austria in World Cup last 32
summary: La Roja enter the clash with a perfect defensive record this tournament, but a history of knockout stage struggles looms.
details: Spain heads into their World Cup last 32 clash against Austria at the SoFi Stadium on the back of a 34-match unbeaten streak. Their defense has remained unbreached throughout the tournament, with goalkeeper Unai Simon going 429 minutes without conceding.

Despite dominating possession, Spain has struggled to break down disciplined defenses, as seen in their 0-0 draw against Cape Verde. This tactical puzzle echoes their 2022 World Cup exit to Morocco, where possession did not translate into goals.

Austria, led by Ralf Rangnick, returns to the World Cup knockout stages for the first time in 72 years. While they are known for a compact defense, they also possess the quality to threaten Spain on the counter-attack.
Spain's record against Austria is strong, being unbeaten in their last five meetings. However, they are wary of their only previous World Cup encounter in 1978, which they lost 2-1.
The stakes are high as Spain has not won a World Cup knockout match since the 2010 final. They have been eliminated on penalties in their last two knockout ties against Russia and Morocco.
The winner of this match will advance to the last 16 and face either Portugal or Croatia on Thursday.
caption:
34 matches unbeaten and a perfect defensive record. Can Spain finally break their knockout curse?

Spain heads into their World Cup last 32 clash against Austria at the SoFi Stadium on the back of a 34-match unbeaten streak. Their defense has remained unbreached throughout the tournament, with goalkeeper Unai Simon going 429 minutes without conceding.

Despite dominating possession, Spain has struggled to break down disciplined defenses, as seen in their 0-0 draw against Cape Verde. This tactical puzzle echoes their 2022 World Cup exit to Morocco, where possession did not translate into goals.

Austria, led by Ralf Rangnick, returns to the World Cup knockout stages for the first time in 72 years. While they are known for a compact defense, they also possess the quality to threaten Spain on the counter-attack.

Spain's record against Austria is strong, being unbeaten in their last five meetings. However, they are wary of their only previous World Cup encounter in 1978, which they lost 2-1.

The stakes are high as Spain has not won a World Cup knockout match since the 2010 final. They have been eliminated on penalties in their last two knockout ties against Russia and Morocco.

The winner of this match will advance to the last 16 and face either Portugal or Croatia on Thursday.
